description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5310010615302 WASHER,LOCK: Line 0001 Qty 9324 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0146 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 932. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 0Y3H3 0123500; 3D6E9 WA110; 3NNX8 10044524; 75Q65 318BX; 78500 WA110. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
